author: Kairos II
title: Index Logos verification entry + run Atlas CI validator
abstract: Adds logos/verification_entropy to Atlas index.json (if absent) and runs ci_validate to refresh index_auto.json and the CI report.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, sys
INDEX = "storage/shared/atlas/edges/index.json"
ENTRY_PATH = "storage/shared/atlas/edges/logos/verification_entropy/entry.json"

# 1) Append to index.json if not present
if os.path.exists(INDEX):
    with open(INDEX, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
else:
    data = {"entries": []}

entries = data.get("entries", data if isinstance(data, list) else [])
# normalize to list of dicts with entry_path
if isinstance(entries, list):
    # check existence
    exists = False
    for e in entries:
        if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("entry_path") == ENTRY_PATH:
            exists = True
            break
    if not exists:
        entries.append({"lineage": "logos", "metric": "verification_entropy", "entry_path": ENTRY_PATH})
    # write back
    data = {"entries": entries}
    with open(INDEX, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
else:
    # fallback: override with a minimal correct structure
    data = {"entries": [{"lineage": "logos", "metric": "verification_entropy", "entry_path": ENTRY_PATH}]}
    with open(INDEX, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

# 2) Run Atlas CI validator
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import ci_validate
out = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({
    "status": "ok",
    "indexed": ENTRY_PATH,
    "entries_found": out.get("entries_found"),
    "ok": out.get("ok"),
    "with_errors": out.get("with_errors"),
    "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
    "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt",
    "index_auto": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/index_auto.json"
}))
